name: Zenra Toukou School
source:
Akira and Shuzuku have finished training for Total Nude Scholastic's Week now the real event is here. As one of the top students of the school and a member of the Volunteer Club Shizuku has been elected as the school's representative during Total Nude Scholastic's Week.

This means that she has to give a speech about naked week to the student body, meet with the city council, pass out fliers in neighboring schools about the event, and be filmed for a documentary about her opinion on Total Nude Scholastic's Week, all while completely naked.

Sometimes joining her is her classmate and new friend Asahina Akari who has done the event many times or her partner Akira, but sometimes she's alone and exposed.
